description: Graph Neural Network inference benchmark using an R-GAT (Relational Graph Attention) proxy model. Multi-head attention over edges with scatter-based aggregation on synthetic random graphs. Pure PyTorch implementation without PyG or DGL. Reports nodes/sec throughput.

scaling_param.name: num_nodes
scaling_param.description: Number of nodes in the synthetic graph

non_scaling_params.name: num_edges
non_scaling_params.description: Number of directed edges in the synthetic graph

non_scaling_params.name: num_heads
non_scaling_params.description: Number of attention heads per GAT layer

non_scaling_params.name: num_layers
non_scaling_params.description: Number of GAT layers in the model
